name: fmmod
expr: y = fmmod(x, fc, fs, 50); y2 = fmmod(x, fc, fs, 50, pi/3);
comment: MATLAB fmmod: frequency modulator y = cos(2π·Fc·t + 2π·freqdev·cumsum(x)/Fs + ini_phase). Covered: default (ini_phase=0) and explicit ini_phase forms over a 100-sample column-vector input. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b within ~1e-10 (Highway sin/cos contributes a few ULP). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship fmmod in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
